decision: Owner decision (2026-10-15), option B: the default Node 24 full-suite gate is satisfied by the required CI verify job passing on Node 24 for the exact head; the intermittent local Windows Node 24.11.1 V8 fatal is recorded as a known issue, not as a failure of the application.
scope: Applies to the Node 24 full-suite gate clauses of HEADLESSLIFECYCLE1 and BROWSERCONTRACTS1 and, for the same clause, WAVECHANNELOBS1. It does NOT close RUNTIMEWASM1 (root-cause verification) and does not claim the V8 fatal is fixed.

knownIssue.symptom: Fatal error / Check failed: jit_page_->allocations_.erase(addr) == 1 (V8 ThreadIsolation::UnregisterWasmAllocation) during isolate disposal; one test file dies at file level in an occasional full local run and passes when run alone.
knownIssue.upstream: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/66366 (open on 2026-10-15; fixed upstream in V8 commit 9b8ca54d5a, not backported to 24.x per the research notes). That this repository's Windows failures share that cause is unconfirmed.
knownIssue.affectedRuntime: Node.js test/MCP/Worker runtime only; not the browser application.
mitigationsNotAdopted: switching CI/test runtime to Node 22 or 26 (not affected upstream; needs a separate full-suite verification and a support decision)

ciEvidence.summary: From run 38679277727 (ec98256) to run 38724981240 (2c19007) there are 28 runs on main: 25 succeeded (verify, deploy and verify-published), 1 failed (38706323710, 6f195bf) and 2 were cancelled because newer commits superseded them (38692909864, 38687710680). Pull-request heads also passed verify before every merge today. Correction after PR 45: the known V8 fatal also occurred once in a pull-request CI run (4be0672, see recordedFailures), so "passes every time" is not accurate; verify passes on a retry/new push. Policy B therefore rests on the required verify passing for the exact head that is merged, not on the fatal never occurring.

recordedFailures.detail: mcp-acoustic-channel-observation ("real MCP harmonic, sweep and channel jobs expose declared recurrence observations without result fields") died with the known V8 fatal "Check failed: jit_page_->allocations_.erase(addr) == 1" in CI on Node 24 (3m40s). The same test passed in earlier CI runs and alone. It was rerun/re-pushed; this first-attempt failure is recorded, not hidden.
mcp-advanced-structural-provenance failed with native heap corruption ('corrupted size vs. prev_size'); not attributed to a cause.
Earlier failure (before the range above) recorded as a V8 failure in docs/evidence/2026-10-15-publication-badce2c-v8-failure.json.

limits: The V8 fatal occurs in CI as well (main 6f195bf, PR head 4be0672); policy B requires a passing verify for the exact merged head and does not claim the fatal is gone.
CI passing repeatedly is not a root fix; failures can recur (one native heap failure occurred in CI today at 6f195bf).
Local Windows full runs still hit the V8 fatal occasionally; rerun the file alone and report it, do not hide it.
Re-check upstream issue 66366 on each new Node 24.x release and revisit this policy when a backport lands.
